notes.subject: בגדוד
notes.rationale: 'namel long ol ami' (king among the troops) vs 'i stap yet olsem king taim ol ami i sanap' — klostu ol tanim tok i tok 'king insait long ami'.

notes.subject: ינחם
notes.rationale: נחם i min tupela: wokim kalm bel na tangre yet — ol man i tangre i kisim kalm bel, tok i tanim long wanpela lain tasol.

notes.subject: ראש
notes.rationale: 'sindaun olsem het' o 'sindaun long hepen' — ראש i min het bilong man o hepen bilong lain.

translation: Mi bin makim rot bilong ol, na mi sindaun olsem het, na mi stap olsem king namel long ol ami, olsem man i wokim kalm bel bilong ol man i tangre.
